reason: I'd use the free first visit for sure, but after that $15 a kid, plus $7 for the baby, adds up fast when storytime and the parks cost nothing. I'd only come back if a coupon or Groupon showed up.
objection: $45 a month plus $15 for the second kid is $60 a month when library storytime and the parks are free. I can't tell what I'd get for that money that I don't already get.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or a 5-visit pack at about $30, or a founding rate under $25 a month for both kids, after a free trial day that actually impressed me.
